description: Same-story headline clusters over a GDELT query pool. Deterministic headline clustering COMPUTED by this service over GDELT headline metadata (title/domain/url/timestamps only; article text is never read): overlap coefficient over normalized headline token sets, threshold 0.40 with at least 3 shared tokens, single-linkage. Not a GDELT-reported grouping. Singletons are counted, not returned. Call gdelt_news_clusters_preflight first to check story counts for free. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/news/clusters.

limit.description: Article pool size the clustering runs over; stated in the response as articles_considered.

name: gdelt_news_clusters
